records.title: 10-Q
records.text: We generated 34% and 38% of our total revenues through Arrow for the three months ended June 30, 2024 and 2023, respectively.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Subscription revenue generated through indirect distribution channels accounted for approximately 90% of total subscription revenue in both the three months ended June 30, 2024 and 2023.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Subscription revenue generated through direct distribution channels accounted for approximately 10% of total subscription revenue in both the three months ended June 30, 2024 and 2023.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: To the extent the U.S. dollar weakens against foreign currencies, the translation of these foreign currency denominated transactions generally results in increased revenues, operating expenses and income from operations for our non-U.S. operations.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: –Net cash provided by operating activities was impacted by net income adjusted for the impact of non-cash charges and a decrease in accounts receivable, partially offset by a decrease in accrued liabilities.
